name: AgroShield
line: Parametric maize insurance for Kenyan smallholders, sold through SACCOs: a rainfall index triggers payouts and every pricing run can be reproduced. Shown on a fictional insurer with illustrative pricing; M-Pesa payment is simulated in the demo.
alt: AgroShield underwriter portfolio page for a fictional demo insurer: policies written, sum insured, gross premium, exposure by ward and payout events.

name: Mapema
line: Forecasts severe pastoral drought one to three months ahead for Kenya's northern pastoral counties, and turns the forecast into a household decision in shillings and an SMS in Kiswahili.
alt: Mapema early action clock for Marsabit in July 2016: a 32 percent chance of severe drought within three months, the advice to prepare, and the SMS a herder receives.

name: Matchday Model
line: A Dixon-Coles football model and the pipeline that turns real match data into pre-match probabilities, a most likely scoreline and an accuracy scorecard after the game.
alt: Matchday Model output slide: home win 63 percent, draw 22 percent, away win 15 percent, most likely scoreline 2-0 in 11 percent of simulations.
